oidc.help: Opens your organization’s sign-in page. PicketX roles and network access remain separate.
oidc.rejected: Organization sign-in failed. Try again or contact your administrator.
oidc.unavailable: Organization sign-in is unavailable. Retry later or use your local sign-in method.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.boundary: Human sign-in and roles only. Account changes grant no network access and do not confirm Agent application.
accounts.discard: Inspect the latest directory and audit first if a save outcome was unknown. Discard this account draft and use the latest revision?
accounts.usernameHelp: 3–64 lowercase ASCII letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens; start with a letter or number. Immutable, never recycled.
accounts.passwordHelp: 12–72 UTF-8 bytes. Cleared when saving; never retained for retry.
accounts.resetHelp: Optional reset: leave empty to retain password. 12–72 UTF-8 bytes when supplied.
accounts.roleHelp: Blocked denies all default operations, even alongside Admin. Roles do not create network Grants.
accounts.reasonHelp: Enter a reason of 1–512 UTF-8 bytes for the permanent account audit.
accounts.confirmHelp: I understand this edit invalidates all previous sessions, including mine if I edit my account.
accounts.sessionHelp: Role-only and same-value edits also invalidate old sessions. Re-enabling does not revive them.
accounts.saved: Account saved. Previous sessions are invalid.
accounts.locked: Inspect the latest directory, then clear the draft before retrying.
accounts.auditHelp: Latest 50 committed changes, newest first. No passwords or hashes. Separate from configuration and Grant audit.

errors.invalid_account: Check username uniqueness, password byte length, roles, reason and the 128-account limit.
errors.account_not_found: The selected account no longer exists. Inspect the latest directory and clear the draft.
errors.revision_mismatch: The account directory changed. Your draft is retained; inspect the latest records before clearing it.

requests.title: Access requests
requests.boundary: Requests grant no access. A different authorized person reviews the explicit source, named entries and deadline. Approval is desired state, not confirmed enforcement.
requests.discard: Discard retained request/review drafts and use the latest catalog? Inspect history first if a write outcome was unknown.
requests.sourceHelp: Enter the source seen by the protected service. Portal login and forwarded headers do not prove it. Other devices using this source share reachability; no tunnel or application credentials are created.
requests.durationHelp: 60–86400 seconds. The server fixes an absolute deadline when saved; waiting for approval does not extend it.
requests.pickEndpoints: Select at least one named entry.
requests.fixFields: Check the linked fields before continuing.
requests.sent: Request saved. No access has been granted.
requests.decided: Decision saved. Approval is not confirmed application.
requests.locked: Writing is blocked; the result may have committed or its base changed. Inspect refreshed history, then explicitly use the latest request catalog before retrying. Drafts are retained.
requests.expiryHelp: Use an RFC3339 timestamp with timezone, later than now and no later than the requested deadline.
requests.ackHelp: I reviewed the explicit shared source, selected entries, deadline and current catalog. Publication is not proof of application.
requests.noSelf: You cannot approve your own request. Another authorized person must review it.
requests.notApplied: Application is not confirmed. Administrators must inspect current node observations and the deployed entry.
requests.empty: No access requests in this page. Submit a request or refresh the review inbox.

errors.request_conflict: This request is no longer pending or its pinned target changed. Refresh history; do not retry approval against a different target.
errors.request_not_found: This request no longer exists. Refresh the inbox.
errors.revision_mismatch: The publication changed. Inspect refreshed history and explicitly use the latest request catalog before retrying.

humanLogin.help: Use your administrator-provisioned local account. Usernames are lowercase; passwords are not trimmed. Password managers and paste are supported.
humanLogin.passwordLimit: Enter a password of 12–72 UTF-8 bytes (up to 24 Chinese characters).
humanLogin.rejected: Sign-in details not accepted. Check them or contact your administrator.
humanLogin.unavailable: Local password sign-in is no longer available. Use an access key or contact your administrator.

publicationConflictHelp: Writing is blocked. Your draft is retained, but the change may have committed. Inspect the latest status and audit, then explicitly reload the latest configuration into the editor before retrying.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.help: Credentialed Agent scopes · read-only Controller observations
nodes.boundary: An Agent report is a point-in-time assertion, not independent kernel verification or a guarantee of current access. Connection, freshness and target match are separate.
nodes.failedRetained: Refresh failed. Retained observations are historical.
nodes.failed: Unable to load node observations. Retry refresh.
nodes.historical: Browser observations are out of date. Treat retained values as historical.
nodes.fresh: Recent report from the same active stream
nodes.stale: Historical report — not a current application claim
nodes.matches: Revision and hash matched the target at last read
nodes.mismatch: Revision or hash did not match the target at last read

routes.acknowledge: I understand new requests for this route will be denied
routes.removeWarning: Remove only this HTTP route. New requests using this UID will be denied. Network Grants, Bindings, other routes and trusted caller configuration stay unchanged; existing streams are not terminated.
routes.missing: This HTTP route is absent from the draft revision. Cancel and inspect the latest inventory; a same-name replacement is a different target.
routes.removed: HTTP route {{uid}} removed. Network Grants and Bindings are unchanged; existing streams are not terminated.
routes.title: HTTP routes
routes.boundary: Desired request selectors only. Source Grants and trusted ingress setup are separate; creation does not confirm access.
routes.rebaseConfirm: Keep this route draft and use the latest revision? Review the pinned TCP endpoint and selectors before retrying.
routes.name: Route name
routes.required: All fields are required except the two path lists: fill at least one. Select each allowed method explicitly.
routes.nameLimit: Enter a nonblank name of at most 128 UTF-8 bytes
routes.reasonLimit: Enter a nonblank reason of at most 512 UTF-8 bytes
routes.hostHelp: Exact hostname or IP, with port when present in Host. No URL scheme, wildcard, slash or whitespace. IPv6 with a port uses brackets.
routes.pathHelp: Exact matches only; /repo does not include /repo/child. Leave blank if using prefixes only. No empty lines, query, fragment, percent encoding, backslash or dot segments. Incoming query strings are ignored.
routes.prefixHelp: /repo includes /repo and /repo/child, not /repository. No trailing slash except /. The same strict path rules apply. Leave blank if using exact paths only.
routes.selectorLimit: Enter 1–128 unique selectors across exact paths and prefixes. Fill at least one list.
routes.rootWarning: Root prefix / includes every canonical path. It still requires matching source Grants, Host and methods.
routes.bodyLimit: The entire request must fit in 16 KiB. Reduce the path list or text.
routes.created: Route {{uid}} created. Configure this exact UID in trusted caller scope and ingress; source access still requires a Grant.
routes.invalid: Check the unique route name, pinned TCP endpoint, exact Host and unique methods/path selectors. Inputs are retained.
routes.conflictHelp: Writing is blocked until you explicitly use the latest route revision. Inspect the route list before retrying: a failed response may still have committed. Your draft is retained.
routes.discardAll: Sign out and discard all unsaved configuration, Resource, Binding, Grant and HTTP route drafts?
routes.empty: No HTTP routes yet. Select a TCP endpoint and define exact request selectors.
routes.setup: This list is desired configuration, not live ingress status. Administrators must separately pin each UID in the trusted caller allowlist and ingress. Use Grants to manage source access.

loginTitle: Control access. Keep the boundary clear.
loginDescription: Sign in to inspect and publish the configuration owned by this Controller.
desiredBoundary: Desired state only. Saving configuration does not confirm node application.
keyHelp: Use your independent management access key. It is exchanged for a server-side session, not saved in browser storage.
sessionBoundary: Single Controller sessions expire after 8 hours or 30 minutes of inactivity. Restart and credential rotation require a new sign-in.
editorHelp: Edit the complete policy and facts document. Shared validation runs before acceptance.
readOnly: Read-only access. Your current role cannot publish changes.
reasonHelp: Explain this change for the append-only publication audit.
noConfiguration: Configuration could not be read. Refresh to retry.
auditHelp: Configuration changes recorded in the same transaction as acceptance. This is not an enforcement or request-decision log.
discard: Discard your unsaved draft and load the latest configuration?
expired: Your session expired or access was revoked. Sign in again.
conflict: The revision changed. Your draft is preserved; reload explicitly before editing again.
saved: Desired configuration saved. Node application is not confirmed.
staleFailed: Last read failed. Displayed data may be stale.
staleAge: This view is over a minute old. Refresh before relying on it.
requestFailed: The request failed. Check connectivity and Controller readiness, then retry.

resources.latestProtected: Protected names at the draft revision
resources.acknowledgeBindingEdit: I reviewed the latest scope and protection changes
resources.bindingEditWarning: Keep this Binding’s identity, Resource, Agent and execution settings. Adding protection may deny service traffic; removing it may expose traffic. Grants and other Bindings stay unchanged. Saving normalizes this Binding document; its comments and formatting may be lost. Publication is not confirmation of Agent application.
resources.bindingScopeChanged: This Binding’s fixed scope or available Endpoints changed. Cancel and reopen it before editing; the retained draft will not move protection.
resources.bindingEndpointsSaved: Protected Endpoint names saved as desired state. Fixed scope and Grants are unchanged; Agent application is not confirmed.
resources.bindingEditHelp: Named single-Resource, single-Agent host Bindings can edit protected Endpoints here. All-endpoint, label selectors and advanced scope changes remain in Desired configuration. Remove Binding withdraws protection, not access.
resources.latestNetwork: Latest target at the draft revision
resources.acknowledgeEdit: I reviewed the latest target and network changes
resources.editMembershipChanged: Endpoint membership changed in the latest revision. Cancel this draft and reopen the Resource before editing.
resources.editWarning: Only unreferenced Resources can be edited here. UID, names and labels stay unchanged. This does not configure or move the application. Saving normalizes this Resource document; its comments and formatting may be lost. Other documents remain unchanged.
resources.editInUse: Resource is referenced. Network edits are blocked even for revoked or expired Grants. Review Grants, Denies, Bindings and HTTPRoutes; nothing was cascaded.
resources.networkSaved: Resource network parameters saved as desired state. Application settings and Agent application are not confirmed.
resources.removeResourceWarning: Remove only this unused Resource definition and its Endpoints. Referenced Resources cannot be removed. This does not stop the application or revoke access.
resources.acknowledgeResource: I understand this removes only the unused Resource definition
resources.missingResource: This Resource is absent from the draft revision. Cancel and inspect the latest inventory; a same-name replacement is a different target.
resources.resourceRemoved: Resource definition removed. No application was stopped and no references were changed.
resources.removeWarning: Removing this Binding withdraws protection, not access. Services may become unprotected. Existing Grants and other Bindings remain.
resources.acknowledge: I understand this may leave services unprotected
resources.missingBinding: This Binding is absent from the draft revision. Cancel and inspect the latest inventory; a same-name replacement is a different target.
resources.removed: Binding removal accepted as desired state. Other Bindings and Grants remain; Agent application is not confirmed.
resources.title: Resources
resources.boundary: Create named service entries, then bind them to an existing host context. This configures protection; it does not grant access or confirm node application.
resources.rebaseConfirm: Keep your inputs and use the latest resource revision? Review Resource identity, Endpoints and the exact context before retrying.
resources.conflictHelp: Writing is blocked until explicit rebase. Inputs are retained. A failed response may have committed: inspect the latest inventory before retrying.
resources.endpointHelp: 1–64 uniquely named TCP/UDP Endpoints. Addresses: one IPv4/IPv6 IP or CIDR per line (or comma). Leave blank to use the Binding destination scope, including both available families; blank does not mean deny all. The server validates addresses and overlap.
resources.uniqueEndpoint: Use a nonblank, unique Endpoint name
resources.portRange: Enter a whole port number from 1 to 65535
resources.contextBoundary: These are operator-configured facts, not live Agent evidence. The selected profile, class, stage, destination boundary and handling are copied without alteration; complete compilation must still succeed.
resources.noContexts: No eligible context is configured. Configure trusted host facts in Desired configuration first; this page does not enroll an Agent.
resources.unsupportedContext: Not selectable here: only host-local/original-destination contexts are supported.
resources.created: Resource accepted as desired state. No access was granted; add a Binding and separate Grant as needed.
resources.bound: Binding accepted as desired state. Node application is not confirmed.
resources.discard: Discard this unsaved Resource or Binding draft?
resources.discardAll: Sign out and discard all unsaved configuration, Resource, Binding and Grant drafts?
resources.empty: No Resources configured. Create a Resource to define its named entries.
resources.emptyBindings: No Bindings configured. Select a Resource and an existing host context to place protection.
resources.selectionHelp: Inspect complete stored selections and execution settings. All-endpoint and label selectors remain dynamic, not fixed named selections. Editing remains in Desired configuration. Remove Binding withdraws protection, not access.

grants.title: Grants
grants.boundary: Each Grant has its own identity and deadline. Grants combine; an explicit deny still wins. Issuance is not confirmation of effective or applied access.
grants.rebaseConfirm: Keep your inputs and use the latest revision for this Grant operation? Review the pinned Resource and scope before submitting again.
grants.name: Grant name
grants.sourceHelp: Enter the actual network source explicitly. A CIDR shares access with every address in that network; this is not a verified person identity.
grants.noResources: No Resources exist. Publish Resource and binding configuration first in Desired configuration.
grants.expiryHelp: The server fixes an absolute expiry once. Reading, retrying or restarting cannot extend it.
grants.selectEndpoints: Select at least one named Endpoint
grants.fixFields: Check the following fields, then submit again.
grants.issued: Grant issued as desired state. Node application is not confirmed.
grants.discardAll: Sign out and discard your unsaved configuration and Grant drafts?
grants.conflictHelp: Writing is blocked until you explicitly use the latest Grant revision. Inputs are retained; a failed response may still have committed. Inspect the latest Grants before retrying.
grants.observed: Validity is evaluated at the last successful read, not live enforcement. Refresh to inspect changes. The YAML editor keeps its separate revision base.
grants.empty: No Grants on this page. Select a Resource and named Endpoints to issue access.
grants.future: Not yet valid at last read
grants.revokeHelp: Only this Grant is revoked. Other matching Grants may continue to allow access; explicit denies are unchanged.
grants.revoked: Grant revoked in desired state. Other Grants and node application must be inspected independently.
grants.finishDraft: Clear or finish the issue draft before revoking. Switching console tabs preserves this draft.

errors.http_route_not_found: This HTTP route no longer exists. Use the latest revision and inspect its UID before retrying.
errors.resource_in_use: Resource is still referenced. Review Grants (including revoked or expired), Denies, Bindings and HTTPRoutes before removing it.
errors.resource_not_found: This Resource no longer exists. Use the latest revision and inspect its UID before retrying.
errors.unauthorized: Access key not accepted. Check the key or contact your administrator.
errors.forbidden: Your current role does not allow this operation.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait briefly before retrying.
errors.invalid_login: Enter a valid management access key.
errors.csrf_rejected: The request could not be verified. Refresh the page and sign in again.
errors.invalid_publication: The desired change did not pass validation. Check the source IP/CIDR, unique Grant name, pinned Resource and named Endpoints, or both configuration documents. Inputs are preserved.
errors.invalid_fields: Check the required fields and allowed duration. Inputs are preserved.
errors.grant_not_found: This Grant no longer exists. Refresh and inspect the current publication.
errors.management_unavailable: Management is unavailable. Check Controller readiness and credential configuration. A failed write response may still have committed; inspect the latest revision before retrying.
errors.session_unavailable: Sessions are unavailable. Check Controller readiness.
errors.request_too_large: The request exceeds the allowed size. Reduce the documents and retry.
errors.body_too_large: The request exceeds the allowed size. Reduce the selected Endpoints or input text.
errors.revision_required: There is no revision base. Explicitly load the latest configuration.
